## Our model now

The walled compound as the plan S01 draws it, on the terrace the dig shows, with every hall drawn by the hall kit from its numbers and adapted to what the texts and the ruin say: 含经堂 seven bays, double-eaved, glazed (S940, S361); 淳化轩 seven by three bays on its terrace (S940, P0404); 蕴真斋 with its porches (S940, S01). No picture of any hall standing survives: every elevation is the kit's (C); the halls of the side courts are their class's (assumed).

- **Layout:** The walled compound and its forecourt as the plan S01 draws them (re-read in Round 17, B), checked against the Yangshi Lei plans 长春园淳化轩 as S940 prints them (figs. 5, 6)
- **Forecourt:** Walls on three sides with the three glazed archways 琉璃坊楔 (S05; their form the class's, C), crossing stone paths and four lawns where the yurts stood (S940 p.360)
- **Terrace:** The compound stands 2.1 m above the forecourt: measured on the ruin photographs P0403, P0505, P0815 (C); the curved edge from S01; the gate's projection 13.5 m wide with three flights as the ruin shows it (S01 draws 24 m, Q244)
- **Gate 宫门:** Five bays (S05 '宫門五楹南嚮'), at its box on S01; doors, bracket band and roof from the hall kit (C)
- **含经堂:** Seven bays and a porch all round (S05; S940 p.360; S01's nine cells), double-eaved 歇山 (S940, S361), yellow glazed (glazed: S361; the colour C, Q143); a front terrace of 0.8 m with a 4.3 m flight before a 1.5 m platform (P0402, C)
- **Court of 含经堂:** The screen wall 影壁 on the axis (S01, S940; its 0.4 m base from P0402), side halls east and west (S940), the two-storey ⊐ ranges 梵香楼 (west) and 霞翥楼 (east) on S01's plan (storeys from the names, C)
- **Galleries and rockery:** The galleries 墨刻游廊 with the 淳化阁帖 stones set in their outer walls (S05 j83:4b; S940 p.361); the rockery between 含经堂 and 淳化轩 (S01, S940; its rocks placed C); plum trees in the court (E0068; places C)
- **淳化轩:** Seven by three bays (S940 p.360), rolled 歇山, glazed (S940 pp.360-361; colour C, Q151); its terrace 17 x 5.5 m with two flights 2.5-3 m in from its ends (S01; P0404)
- **蕴真斋:** Seven bays with porches front and back (S940 p.360; S01's cross), its front arm a terrace; rolled grey 歇山 (C)
- **Side courts:** Every hall inside the wall at its box, drawn from its class by the hall kit (assumed); 三友轩 at its measured 11.1 x 7.2 m on 11.9 x 8.3 m (S940 p.364) with pine, bamboo and plum (S940); 渊映斋 five bays and the dressing room's platform from P0410; the stage 乐奏钧天 as a two-storey pavilion (C)
- **Assumed:** Every elevation (no picture of any hall standing survives), the halls of the side courts, the archways' faces, the north gate, the flights on the curves: from the hall kit's classes and the Qing manual's typology (C, the pale tint with conf=1)

## Texts and drawings (7)

- **E0088** (poem, sure): 静莲斋. 乾隆三十五年 (1770) · v3 p.252, under 含经堂; source ref 10-707 · S361. https://www.yuanmingyuanpark.cn/xs/yjbg/202008/P020200803382569071850.pdf#page=255
  > 斋前本无池，无池安得莲。然则奚名斋，寓意有取焉。芳葩植瓶中，奇峰耸庭前。曰假假固非，谓真真实然。而此非了义，半提讵提全。绣佛供花龛，见叶贮珠编。时偶值几暇，净几几页翻。可以空五蕴，可以息万缘。静乃在斯乎，青莲口所宣。
  Poem 静莲斋 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1770, filed by the editors under 含经堂.
- **E0089** (poem, sure): 静莲斋. 乾隆三十六年 (1771) · v3 p.257, under 含经堂; source ref 10-857 · S361. https://www.yuanmingyuanpark.cn/xs/yjbg/202008/P020200803382569071850.pdf#page=260
  > 一间静室避歊炎，瓶供莲华水贮奁。识得色香本无处，底须几上置楞严。
  Poem 静莲斋 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1771, filed by the editors under 含经堂.
- **E0090** (poem, sure): 静莲斋. 乾隆三十八年 (1773) · v3 p.260, under 含经堂; source ref 11-436 · S361. https://www.yuanmingyuanpark.cn/xs/yjbg/202008/P020200803382569071850.pdf#page=263
  > 缀景萧斋额静莲，不关玩物不参禅。即如周氏称君子，岂弗宜珍座席边。
  Poem 静莲斋 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1773, filed by the editors under 含经堂.
- **E2497** (description, sure): 紫禁城宁寿宫区与长春园含经堂区建筑关系探讨 (王文涛, 故宫学刊 2015): the 含经堂 layout from the dig. 2015 · pp.358-367 (PDF pp.6-15) · S672. https://www.dpm.org.cn/Uploads/File/2020/03/27/u5e7db6f5d6c90.pdf
  From the dig and the archives: the compound is about 300 m north-south by 200 m east-west. Forecourt with three glazed pailou (east, south, west) and four lawns where yurts stood; five-bay gate with a 垂花门 each side; 含经堂 a seven-bay double-eaved hip-and-gable hall with side halls and the towers 霞翥楼 and 梵香楼; 淳化轩 seven by three bays, the largest single building of Changchun Yuan, hip-and-gable (rolled ridge on p.360, glazed on p.361); 蕴真斋 seven bays with front and back porches; 渊映斋 and 涵光室 five-bay hip-and-gable; 三友轩 three bays, measured about 11.1 x 7.2 m on a platform 11.9 x 8.3 m; 静莲斋 five bays; 理心楼 five bays; 待月楼 a three-bay two-storey hip-and-gable tower facing east; 澄波夕照 and 得胜概 three-bay open halls; a two-storey stage 乐奏钧天 with a five-bay viewing hall 神心妙达 rebuilt in mid-Jiaqing. Floor heating survives in five halls. The remains are Qianlong work with some of the 1814 rebuilding, nothing later. 淳化轩 was the model for 乐寿堂 in the 宁寿宫.
- **E0059** (description, likely): 嘉庆帝所题圆明园淳化轩诗考析 (尤李). 2023-08-16 post · jzys · S337. http://iqh.ruc.edu.cn/old/qdhjylyjzx/xszl/jzys/0bc9dd46ac1b4792b33bab6f8a9eb883.htm
  Through Jiaqing's poems. It dates the addition of 淳化轩, 蕴真斋, 三友轩, 静莲斋, 待月楼 and 理心楼 behind 含经堂 to 1770, when the compound reached full size. The 重刻淳化阁帖 stones were set in the galleries in front of 淳化轩.
- **E0057** (description, sure): 圆明园五朝御制诗文集注 v3, editors' note on 含经堂. 2020 edition · v3 p.244 · S361. https://www.yuanmingyuanpark.cn/xs/yjbg/202008/P020200803382569071850.pdf#page=247
  The largest group in this garden, finished 1747, rebuilt 1770 with 淳化轩, 蕴真斋, 三友轩, 静莲斋, 待月楼 and 理心楼. 含经堂 is a seven-bay double-eaved glazed hall; 霞翥楼 mirrors 梵香楼 and, with the inner plaque 味腴书室, held the 四库全书荟要, which identifies our 味腴书屋. A stage was added east of 淳化轩 in 1814. Guards were still posted after 1860.
- **E2491** (archaeology, sure): 紫禁城宁寿宫区与长春园含经堂区建筑关系探讨 (王文涛, 故宫学刊 2015). 2015 · pp.358-367 (PDF pp.6-15), figs 4-9, 30-34 · S940. https://www.dpm.org.cn/Uploads/File/2020/03/27/u5e7db6f5d6c90.pdf
  Compares the Ningshou Gong in the Forbidden City with the Hanjing Tang compound, which Qianlong built in phases from 1745 to 1771 for his retirement. It lists each hall's bays and roof, measures 三友轩 on the ruin, and describes some twenty underfloor heating systems found in the 2001-03 dig, with flue sizes. Figures include Yangshi Lei sheets of 淳化轩 (Qianlong and Jiaqing) at the NLC and the late plan from 金勋's collection.

**On the plan:** Drawn on the plan of the gardens (S01), labelled 静莲斋, 5x2 cells. https://artmuseum.princeton.edu/collections/objects/138657
